title: System Assessment
description: Read-only assessment of a workstation's security posture: inventory, disk, memory, services and exposure, patching and encryption. Produces an evidence-backed posture report. Makes no changes.

constraints: - You MUST run scripts/inventory.sh and capture its JSON output
- You MUST report the OS family, version, kernel, privilege level and hostname
- You MUST NOT modify the system — this taskrail is read-only from end to end
- You MUST flag any field the inventory returned as 'unknown' and why
rail.validation: Report the OS, kernel, privilege level and any fields the inventory could not determine.

constraints: - You MUST inspect the disk usage figures from the inventory
- You MUST flag any filesystem above 85% usage as a risk
- You MUST note whether disk encryption was detected (luks-present / none-detected / unknown)
- You SHOULD recommend free-space thresholds appropriate to the workload
rail.validation: Report per-filesystem usage, flag anything above 85%, and state the encryption status.

constraints: - You MUST inspect memory, swap and load-average figures from the inventory
- You MUST flag swap usage above 50% as a risk
- You MUST compare the 1-minute load average against the CPU count and flag sustained saturation
- You SHOULD distinguish steady-state pressure from a transient spike
rail.validation: Report memory, swap and load with an explicit risk verdict for each.

constraints: - You MUST list the listening sockets from the inventory, grouped by interface (loopback vs all-interfaces)
- You MUST flag every service listening on an all-interfaces address as externally reachable
- You MUST report the firewall status and warn if it is inactive or unknown
- You SHOULD identify any listening service that is unexpected for a workstation
rail.validation: Report the externally-reachable listeners, firewall status, and any surprising service.

constraints: - You MUST report the pending-update count from the inventory
- You MUST flag pending updates as a risk, noting that no severity is available from the count alone
- You MUST NOT install updates — recommending is the limit of this agent's authority
- You SHOULD suggest a maintenance window rather than immediate action
rail.validation: Report the pending-update count and a patching recommendation without taking action.

constraints: - You MUST compile the findings into a concise posture summary with a risk rating per area
- You MUST separate findings by severity and mark anything needing human attention
- You MUST provide the exact remediation for each finding, marked as a recommendation only
- You MUST NOT claim any change was made — none are made by this agent
- You MAY produce the summary as JSON conforming to schemas/posture-report.json
rail.validation: Provide a final posture summary with per-area risk ratings and clearly-marked recommendations.
